newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: REBELS ATTACK PHILIPPINE POLICE OUTPOST, KILL TWO.
newsitem.headline: REBELS ATTACK PHILIPPINE POLICE OUTPOST, KILL TWO.

text.p: About 70 communist rebels attacked a farflung police outpost east of Manila on Sunday, killing two people and injuring several others, police investigators in the Philippines said.
They said armed rebels, including some women, strafed the outpost in Rizal province shortly before noon, gunning down a police officer and a still unidentified civilian.
The number of people injured was not immediately known.
The rebels were aboard two garbage dumptrucks as they swooped down on the outnumbered policemen. Seven policemen were assigned to man the outpost in a sparsely populated and mountainous area.
A local police officer said witnesses saw some injured rebels being carried out by their comrades as the besieged policemen engaged them in a short gunbattle.
The motive for the attack was unclear.
Local communist leaders are conducting peace talks with the Philippine government to end a 28-year insurgency.
